summary: Containerized AAP 2.6 requires RHEL 9.4+ or RHEL 10, x86_64/AArch64/s390x/ppc64le, ansible-core from AppStream (2.14 on RHEL 9, 2.16 on RHEL 10), PostgreSQL 15 managed or 15-17 external, and IPv4/IPv6.
questions: What RHEL versions does AAP 2.6 containerized support?
Which PostgreSQL versions work with AAP 2.6?
Which ansible-core do I need to install AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: AAP 2.6 containerized system requirements
answer_card.answer_md:
- **OS**: RHEL 9.4+ or RHEL 10
- **CPU arch**: x86_64, AArch64, s390x, ppc64le
- **ansible-core** (from AppStream): 2.14 on RHEL 9, 2.16 on RHEL 10
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15 (managed); 15, 16 or 17 external (ICU support; 16/17 need external backup)
- **IP**: IPv4, IPv6, dual-stack
- **Browser**: current Firefox or Chrome
